description: Annalisa Sheehan, Calvin Jephcote and John Gulliver publish modelled annual average daily traffic for twelve study areas in seven European countries. The April 2026 ZIP contains road-link shapefiles from the combined XGBoost model, freely downloadable for non-commercial use under CC BY-NC 4.0. Fields identify a cleaned road link, predicted traffic, road classes and the original OpenStreetMap identifier. Training observations cover 4,744 counting sites, mostly around 2019. These estimates can drive traffic-emission, noise or network-demand simulations. Cleaning splits some original OSM links, so osm_id is not necessarily unique. Predictions have minimum-value thresholds and should be locally calibrated before transfer. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these estimates. Model code is available only by request according to the paper; it was not obtained. The data and model performance were not independently checked.
